## Description

Ranks commodity futures contracts based on the slope of their futures curve (backwardation vs contango) to capture roll yield differential while hedging broad commodity directional exposure.

## Where it may fit

Physical commodity supply/demand imbalances, inflationary macro cycles, storage cost shifts.

## Vehicles

CTA managed futures, commodity hedge funds, multi-asset macro strategies.

## Required data

Commodity futures term-structure curve data, contract expiration schedules, roll dates, storage costs.

## Caveats

Contract liquidity shifts sharply near notice dates; roll timing execution logic is critical to prevent physical delivery risks.
